verdict.rationale: Snyk ships an official, actively maintained CLI (github.com/snyk/cli) installable via brew, usable locally, in IDEs, and CI/CD, with verified commands like `snyk test`, `snyk code test`, and `snyk fix --agentic`; it also embeds an MCP server for agentic workflows, directly serving AI-native/agentic use cases. Hands-on probes confirm installation and functionality, though scanning requires authentication.
